components.name: Producing Service
components.purpose: Submits a tenant-scoped idempotent notification intent.

components.name: Notification API
components.purpose: Validates and durably accepts notification intents.

components.name: Notification Database
components.purpose: Stores intents, outbox work, attempts and terminal states.

components.name: Routing Service
components.purpose: Chooses eligible channels, priority and send time.

components.name: Preference Service
components.purpose: Owns versioned opt-outs, quiet hours and channel preferences.

components.name: Channel Queues
components.purpose: Separate bounded delivery queues by channel and priority.

components.name: Delivery Workers
components.purpose: Lease work, recheck eligibility and drive provider attempts.

components.name: Provider Adapters
components.purpose: Apply provider quotas, idempotency and request translation.

components.name: External Providers
components.purpose: Accept email, SMS or push requests with provider-specific guarantees.

components.name: Receipt Handler
components.purpose: Validates callbacks and idempotently records provider delivery events.

components.name: Dead-letter Queue
components.purpose: Holds exhausted or poison work for controlled investigation and replay.

alternatives: At-least-once attempts with a documented duplicate risk
tradeoffs.guidance: An API timeout cannot prove whether a provider already sent the notification.
Failover can improve availability but also duplicate an already-accepted send.

dataModel.notes: Unique tenant idempotency keys prevent duplicate accepted intents.
Use a due-work index and conditional state transitions.
Recheck the relevant version before dispatch.
Validate and deduplicate callbacks, including out-of-order events.

flows.name: Accept and deliver
steps: API validates the tenant-scoped idempotency key and request fingerprint
Atomically store intent and recoverable dispatch work
Router applies preferences and emits per-channel work
Worker leases work, rechecks eligibility and obeys provider quotas
Record provider acceptance and reconcile final receipts

flows.name: Failure
steps: Classify a provider error as transient, permanent or uncertain
Retry with bounded backoff or reconcile an uncertain provider reference
Dead-letter exhausted work with safe operator metadata, not raw message contents
